zh-CN: 本地后续维护：未压缩目录可单项或批量更新，同路径再次添加继续原记录；删改先确认，未变化指纹和预览复用，支持原位置修复。
稳定仓库批量操作栏的计数、按钮与右侧操作布局，避免窗口宽度变化时随意换行或拉伸。
仓库搜索去除红色聚焦外圈，库存、标签和 GB 指标改用中性悬浮与键盘聚焦反馈。
列表与缩略图点击条目均定位到项目详情，保留复制和选择手势的独立行为。
移除备份位置标签与内容之间的多余间隔，将外部仓库入口统一改为“导入仓库”。
页码框去除上下微调按钮，点击显示候选列表，同时保留直接编辑、Enter/失焦提交和无效输入处理。
不更改仓库格式、用户资料位置或现有记录，无需迁移或重建数据。
en-US: Local maintenance: refresh uncompressed folders individually or in batches; reuse same-source records, review changes, retain unchanged fingerprints and previews, and relocate originals manually.
Stabilize Warehouse selection counts, bulk buttons, and right-side actions as the window changes width.
Remove the red search focus ring and use neutral hover and keyboard focus feedback for Inventory, Tags, and GB metrics.
Item clicks in list and thumbnail views both scroll to details while copying and selection gestures remain independent.
Remove extra spacing inside the Backup location pill and use Import Warehouse consistently for the import entry and title.
Replace page spinner buttons with a clickable candidate list while preserving direct editing, Enter/blur submission, and invalid-input handling.
The Warehouse format, user-data locations, and existing records are unchanged; no migration or rebuild is required.
